title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - HealthWearable
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/HealthWearable. Health-related Wearable, sub-class of SAREF4WEAR Wearable (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthDevice AND s4wear:WearableDevice (equivalence declared with SAREF4WEAR per ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.4: 'HealthWearable class is equivalent to SAREF4WEAR Wearable class. It will therefore not be described within clause 4.2.3... in order to reduce duplication with SAREF4WEAR documentation, see ETSI TS 103 410-9 for details'). It therefore inherits every property of HealthDevice (serialNb, isAttachedTo, hasInterface, locationRelativeToBody, availableFlash, availableRam, remainingBatteryLevel, computingPower, powerSource, rechargeable, numberOfPowerSource, availablePowerLevel, dimensions, weight, sendingFrequency, precision, hasFunction -- see standards/saref4ehaw/models/HealthDevice/schema.json) plus SAREF4WEAR WearableDevice's own properties (out of this candidate's 21-class scope, since SAREF4WEAR itself is not part of this translation), with nothing of its own declared in the SAREF4EHAW ontology.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'HealthWearable'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
